metadata.description: mvacoimbra's Claude Code mods: personal forks of community mods

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: One /mods pane with a tab per installed mod: each mod's state, settings and actions in one place

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins for Claude Code: tool rows that open onto their input and answer, highlighted code, diff, table, math, Mermaid and shell cards, links, folding, a usage band, a calm mode and fifteen themes. Set them in the Skins tab of /mods.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel opened from /mods: running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.
